_doc: NVIDIA Build/NIM capability matrix. Method: LIVE single-shot probes on our own API key (not model-card theory) with per-model timeout. RE-VALIDATED 2026-07-17 (10 days after the 2026-07-07 baseline) — the endpoint drifted HARD: 4 of 6 role-models broke. kimi-k2.6 -> HTTP 404 (gone), mistral-large-3-675b -> HANGS >22s, gpt-oss-120b -> EMPTY content via our text adapter, llama-4-maverick -> HANGS >22s. Only minimax-m3 (default) and nemotron-3-nano (fast) survived. Replacements were found by probing the live 119-model catalog with a real coding prompt: nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b (coding), deepseek-v4-flash (reasoning; it ERRORED on 07-07 but RECOVERED), mistral-small-4-119b-2603 (review). deepseek-v4-PRO still HANGS — only FLASH is safe. NVIDIA is called SINGLE-SHOT as a tool (not the agent runtime), so raw quality + a non-hanging clean response is what counts. Lead/Boss ALWAYS runs on Claude Opus 4.8. RE-PROBE before trusting after ~1 week: models come and go on this endpoint. RE-VALIDATED AGAIN 2026-07-25 (8 days after 07-17) — good news: all 6 distinct role-models (default/fast=coding-fast/reasoning/review/coding/vision) responded correctly on a live minimal chat call, 0 broken this round. Notably llama-4-maverick (vision) RECOVERED from its 07-17 HANG (>22s) -> now WORKING (340ms, clean). vision stays tier=avoid regardless because the adapter is still TEXT-ONLY (no image-block support) — real screenshot/vision analysis still runs on Claude UI Boss, not NVIDIA. No fallback probes were needed (nothing was broken). RE-PROBE before trusting after ~1 week: this endpoint flip-flops both ways (07-07 OK -> 07-17 broken -> 07-25 OK again, for vision). RE-VALIDATED 2026-09-24 (wp19, run forge-2026-09-24-config-v250; ~2 months after 07-25) — the endpoint drifted HARD again: the live /models list had 82 ids and 6 of 7 role slots (default/fast/coding-fast/reasoning/review/vision) pointed at ids no longer listed; one chat probe each returned HTTP 410 Gone ('has reached its end of life') for nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b, deepseek-v4-flash, mistral-small-4-119b-2603 and llama-4-maverick-17b-128e-instruct. Only coding (nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b) survived. Method: module API chat(), prompt 'Reply with exactly: OK', max_tokens 16 (thinking models re-probed once with headroom), 25 s timeout, ONE network request per probe (the adapter's retries were refused locally), strictly sequential, 16 probes in total (budget 25). PROBE TABLE 2026-09-24 (model: status, latency, reply head): nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b: 410, 98ms | deepseek-v4-flash: 410, 38ms | mistral-small-4-119b-2603: 410, 38ms | llama-4-maverick-17b-128e-instruct: 410, 40ms | mistral-nemotron: ok, 365ms, 'OK' | nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b: timeout >25s | gemma-4-31b-it: timeout >25s | nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b @16 tok: ok, 541ms, verbose reasoning text (finish=length) | nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b @300 tok: ok, 724ms, 'OK' | deepseek-v4.1-flash: timeout >25s | nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning: HTTP 503, 152ms | glm-5.3 @16 tok: no visible content, 464ms (finish=length, all tokens spent thinking) | glm-5.3 @400 tok: ok, 929ms, 'OK' | llama-3.2-90b-vision-instruct: timeout >25s | llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct: ok, 154ms, 'OK' | kimi-k3 @400 tok: timeout >25s. NEW ROLE MAP 2026-09-24: default/fast/coding-fast -> mistralai/mistral-nemotron; reasoning -> nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b (shares the coding model); review -> z-ai/glm-5.3; coding unchanged; vision -> meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct (still tier=avoid: the adapter is text-only). A liveness ping proves a model answers, not how good it is at a role — see honesty. RE-PROBE before trusting after ~1 week.

premiumFallback.when: Lead/Boss ALWAYS Opus 4.8. High-risk reasoning, architecture, deep code review, final QA, security, complex planning, AND all real vision/screenshot analysis (adapter is text-only) -> Claude. Sonnet 5 is the price/performance fallback; Opus 4.8 is accuracy-first. NVIDIA reduces cost on bulk in-task work; it never replaces a premium assignment and never handles the final verdict.

honesty: Every ROLE model (default/fast/coding-fast/reasoning/review/coding/vision) was re-probed live again on 2026-07-25 (8 days after 07-17) — this time all 6 distinct role-models responded correctly (0 broken), including vision recovering from its 07-17 hang. Catalog entries NOT in an active role (mistral-nemotron, thinkingmachines/inkling, nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning, mistral-medium-3.5-128b, deepseek-v4-pro) were left at their 07-17 probe date — they were out of scope for this run and are correspondingly stale by this file's own ~1-week rule. The 2026-07-07 matrix was 4/6 stale within 10 days — model cards and benchmarks did NOT predict which models hang, 404, or return empty on this endpoint; flakiness runs both ways (a model can recover too, as vision did here). Re-probe with a real chat call (see .claude/forge-bin/nvidia-provider.cjs) after ~1 week before trusting any entry. CONSOLIDATION ROUND (2026-07-26, WP-NVIDIA-CONSOLIDATE, owner directive to keep only the fewest genuinely-best-in-class models): 10 live cross-probes compared nemotron-3-nano/nemotron-3-super/deepseek-v4-flash head-to-head on the SAME real mini-tasks (summarize, translate-rewrite, code-draft edge-case, research-digest, data-extract) — full evidence lives in function-model-fit.json (functions.*.alts + the new `consolidation` block), not duplicated here. Net effect on THIS file: only the `default` ROLE model changed (minimax-m3 -> nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b, evidence in roles.default.why); the `reasoning`/`review`/`coding`/`fast`/`coding-fast`/`vision` ROLE bindings are UNCHANGED — this round only reassigned which model backs each FUNCTION in function-model-fit.json, plus this one ROLE remap that was explicitly in scope. minimax-m3 and mistral-small-4-119b-2603 remain in the catalog (not deleted) as historical/reference entries since neither is provably broken, just no longer the best-in-class pick for anything currently routed. RE-VALIDATION 2026-09-24 (wp19): 16 single-shot live probes (budget 25), each one real network request, strictly sequential. Every ROLE model now answers a live minimal chat AND is in the live /models list. What a ping does NOT prove: role quality. mistral-nemotron (default/fast/coding-fast) and glm-5.3 (review) are liveness-verified only for their new roles — neither was cross-probed on real role tasks; nemotron-3-super (reasoning) has real reasoning-task evidence from 2026-07-26. Four former role models were observed returning HTTP 410 Gone; five candidates timed out and one returned HTTP 503 — each on a single probe, so a timeout or 503 is a data point, not a permanent verdict. OPEN GAP (outside wp19 scope): function-model-fit.json still pins the dead nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b for doc-draft, data-extract and summarize, so those --function calls hit HTTP 410 until a function-fit re-probe reassigns them (route warns BROKEN/avoid for them now). Catalog entries in no role that were not probed today were only checked against the /models list: delisted ones are set to tier=avoid, their older probe text is kept verbatim. UPDATE later on 2026-09-24 (wp19 follow-up, requested by the coordinator): the OPEN GAP above is CLOSED — 11 same-task cross-probes re-pointed doc-draft and summarize to nemotron-3-super and data-extract to glm-5.3 (evidence in function-model-fit.json); every allowed route <agent> --function <fn> now resolves with 0 warnings. NEW RISK: mistral-nemotron (default/fast/coding-fast) answered its ping in 365ms but timed out (>25 s) on 3 of 4 real-task probes and code-fenced its only answer. Role calls use the adapter's 120 s timeout, so they may still answer, slowly — the binding stays as is until a real-task role re-probe decides.
